config.hero: a child who can step into paintings

bible.title: Behind the Gilded Frames
bible.premise: Sneaking your stray kitten into the quiet museum seemed safe until she pounced straight through an orchard painting. Now you must climb into the canvases to find her before the morning sun seals her in oil paint forever.
bible.heart: You promised your shivering stray kitten she would never be abandoned again, and losing her to the canvas means breaking that sacred vow.
bible.goal: Find your lost kitten across the painted landscapes and carry her safely back to the real museum hall.
bible.danger: Nella, a painted gallery warden, stalks the borders of every frame with a sponge of solvent to rub out any living intruder who disturbs the artwork.
bible.world: The quiet municipal gallery holds four linked paintings: an autumnal apple orchard, a misty river bend, a rainy boulevard, and a starlit observatory. Stepping across a frame feels like parting cool silk, but the painted worlds smell of linseed oil and damp grass. Time moves at the pace of brushstrokes, and painted food tastes sweet but never fills your belly.

characters.name: Nella
characters.description: A tall painted warden in a stiff velvet coat who wants every canvas kept pristine and uses a solvent sponge to erase any living thing that does not belong.

characters.name: Soren
characters.description: A lonely fruit-picker inside the sunlit orchard canvas who wants to keep your kitten as his companion because painted apples never purr.

characters.name: Zora
characters.description: A quiet astronomer from the midnight watercolor who maps the hidden seams between frames and wants a real keepsake from outside the canvas.

characters.name: Lyle
characters.description: A boy fishing on the misty riverbank who wants someone to hold his bamboo rod so he can step away from his post for the first time in fifty years.

rules: You can only enter or exit a painting where its wooden frame touches a shadow on the gallery floor.
Crossing between two canvases requires finding a patch where their paint colors match exactly.
Any living visitor who falls asleep inside a canvas becomes part of the painting when morning light hits the glass.
Painted objects melt into odorless, wet pigment if carried out into the real museum.

pages.text:
Your coat pocket still feels warm, but it is empty. Only ten minutes ago, Barnaby was a shivering scrap of calico fur shivering under a rainspout. You promised her a warm saucer of milk and a home where nobody would ever lock her out again. Sneaking her into the quiet gallery was only supposed to keep her dry until the streetcars started running.

Then she saw a painted moth flutter across an autumn canvas. With one reckless leap, Barnaby pounced straight through the heavy gilt frame. The canvas did not tear. It rippled like water, swallowed her whole, and left only a tiny orange paw print drying in the paint.

Where the frame casts a dark shadow on the floorboards, the golden grass inside sways in a breeze you can actually feel.

choices.text: Step through the shadowed frame into the painted orchard.
Call softly into the canvas to coax Barnaby back out.

factsAdded.text: Barnaby the calico kitten jumped inside the orchard painting.
The orchard canvas ripples like water where its frame touches floor shadow.

pages.illustrationPrompt: a small calico kitten curled tightly inside a wool coat pocket

pages.choiceText: Step through the shadowed frame into the painted orchard.
pages.text:
Stepping through feels like parting cold silk. The quiet gallery vanishes, replaced by warm air and crunchy grass that smells of damp linseed oil. Up in a knotted apple tree, tiny calico ears twitch. Barnaby is safe for now, batting happily at a leaf that refuses to fall.

Before you can reach the bough, a boy in patched dungarees scoops her into his arms. "Mine now," he whispers, hugging her tight against his faded shirt. "I'm Soren. The apples here never spoil, but they never purr either. I've waited fifty years for something warm."

Down the lane, heavy boots crunch against dry paint. A sharp reek of turpentine cuts through the orchard. Nella the warden is marching between the trees, clutching a drippy grey sponge.

choices.text: Plead with Soren to hand Barnaby back right now.
Pull Soren into hiding before the warden spots you.

factsAdded.text: Soren scooped up Barnaby to keep as his companion.
Nella the warden is searching the orchard with a solvent sponge.

pages.illustrationPrompt: a knotted apple tree with stiff golden leaves

pages.choiceText: Call softly into the canvas to coax Barnaby back out.
pages.text:
You whisper Barnaby's name against the canvas and click your tongue. A faint mew chirps back from deep among the painted rows. Then a young fruit-picker in patched overalls steps from behind a gnarled apple tree, holding your squirming calico kitten tightly in his arms.

"Finders keepers," the boy says through the oil paint. His voice sounds muffled, like someone calling from underwater. "I am Soren. Painted apples never purr, but she does. She stays with me."

Behind you, stiff boots click on the gallery floorboards. Nella, the tall painted warden in a dark velvet coat, marches along the wall with a dripping sponge of solvent. She rubs out any living intruder who disturbs the art, and she is heading right toward you.

choices.text: Step through the shadow into the painted orchard.
Plead with Soren across the canvas before the warden arrives.

factsAdded.text: Soren the orchard fruit-picker is holding Barnaby.
Nella the warden is approaching with her solvent sponge.

pages.illustrationPrompt: a gnarled apple tree heavy with red fruit

pages.choiceText: Step through the shadow into the painted orchard.
pages.text:
You plunge through the cool shadow where the frame meets the floor. The museum vanishes, and your boots leave dark footprints across the painted grass.

The orchard air smells of linseed oil. Soren stumbles down a dirt path toward a misty river, clutching Barnaby tight. High above, Nella’s shadow looms against the painted sky. A wet hiss echoes as her sponge wipes the golden edge down to raw linen.

"She is scrubbing us out!" Soren cries, frozen with panic. Barnaby wriggles in his grip, crying for you.

choices.text: Pull Soren along toward the misty river.
Snatch Barnaby from Soren's grip and run alone.

factsAdded.text: You stepped inside the orchard painting.
Nella has begun wiping away the orchard with solvent.
A dirt path leads downhill toward a misty river.

pages.illustrationPrompt: a trail of fresh footprints pressed into painted blades of grass

pages.choiceText: Plead with Soren across the canvas before the warden arrives.
pages.text:
"Please, she is mine," you whisper, pressing your open hand against the canvas. "I swore I would never abandon her."

Soren flinches. Barnaby nips his painted thumb, purring loud enough to rustle the golden leaves. "Nella will scrub you flat if she catches you out there," Soren warns, retreating into the painted orchard. "Jump through where the frame's shadow touches! But if you come inside, you must trade me your warm woolen scarf. I want something real."

Behind you, Nella rounds the marble pillar, lifting her dripping sponge with a grim smile.

choices.text: Leap through the frame shadow into the orchard.
Sprint down the gallery hallway to lead Nella away.

factsAdded.text: Nella cornered you right at the orchard frame.
Soren offered shelter inside the orchard in exchange for your warm woolen scarf.

pages.illustrationPrompt: A flat hand pressed firmly against the rippling surface of an oil painting.

pages.choiceText: Plead with Soren to hand Barnaby back right now.
Pull Soren into hiding before the warden spots you.
Leap through the frame shadow into the orchard.
pages.text:
You dive through the shadow, parting the canvas like cool silk. You tumble onto thick painted grass under a gnarled apple tree, just as Nella's wet sponge strikes harmlessly against the gilded border behind you.

Soren retreats toward a wooden ladder, clutching Barnaby tightly. Barnaby lets out a plaintive mew, trying to squirm free toward your boots. "My scarf first," Soren insists, holding out a pale hand. "You promised. Real wool stays warm, even when morning comes."

Through the leaves, the painted dawn begins to glow. If you unwrap your scarf, Soren might snatch it and run deeper into the orchard. If you refuse, he will never hand Barnaby over.

Lunge forward to snatch Barnaby from Soren's arms.

factsAdded.text: You are inside the orchard painting.

pages.illustrationPrompt: a gnarled apple tree with heavy branches and thick painted roots

pages.choiceText: Sprint down the gallery hallway to lead Nella away.
pages.text:
You bolt down the parquet hallway, your sneakers squeaking against the polished oak. Behind you, Nella’s heavy boots keep terrifying pace, her solvent sponge dripping pale drops onto the floor. "There is no running from the collection," she calls, voice flat as dry canvas.

You round an alcove and skid before a painting of a misty river bend. Inside, a boy in a wool cap perches on a willow branch, clutching a bent bamboo rod. His line jerks violently toward the churning water.

"I am Lyle!" he gasps, leaning toward the frame's edge. "Take the rod, or the river takes me!" Behind you, Nella's velvet coat sweeps around the corner, sponge raised high.

choices.text: Grab Lyle's rod to pull him back from the water.
Dodge past Nella and sprint back to the orchard.

factsAdded.text: Lyle the river fisher needs help landing a dangerous catch.
Nella chased you to the river bend painting.

pages.illustrationPrompt: a tall warden in a dark velvet coat holding a dripping sponge

pages.choiceText: Pull Soren along toward the misty river.
Snatch Barnaby from Soren's grip and run alone.
Untie your scarf and offer it to Soren.
pages.text:
You unwind the thick woolen scarf and hold it out with both hands. Soren’s eyes widen. He gently lets go of Barnaby, snatching the wool and pressing it to his cheek like a long-lost treasure. Barnaby scrambles straight into your arms, purring like a tiny motor as you tuck her safely inside your coat pocket.

Behind you, a sharp hiss cuts through the quiet air. Dark solvent oozes along the canvas edge, dissolving the exit shadow into a puddle of greasy gray pigment. Nella is scrubbing the threshold away from the outside.

"You cannot go back that way," Soren warns, pointing toward the orchard ridge where morning grass fades into pale blue water. "The river painting touches there. The blues match perfectly."

choices.text: Dash toward the blue mist into the river painting.
Try to pry through the melting canvas before it seals shut.

factsAdded.text: Barnaby is safely back inside your coat pocket.

pages.choiceText: Lunge forward to snatch Barnaby from Soren's arms.
pages.text:
You lunge forward, your outstretched hand grabbing Barnaby by the scruff just as Soren stumbles backward. He crashes into a bushel of painted apples, which clatter like wooden blocks. Barnaby scrambles straight into your zipped jacket, purring against your collarbone like a tiny motor.

"Thief!" Soren shouts, rubbing his bruised elbow. "You broke your word!"

Behind you, the canvas shudders. Nella presses her dripping sponge flat against the border, melting a grey hole right through the grass. The gallery shadow is shrinking fast under the morning skylight. Ahead, the orchard slope bleeds directly into the pale reeds of a misty river painting.

choices.text: Dive through the closing shadow back into the gallery.
Run toward the pale reeds of the river painting.

factsAdded.text: You have Barnaby safe inside your jacket.
